notes: «وروى الشلمغاني في كتاب الأوصياء» names a person and a book title: the source is known by title as well as name (rule 11).
«فخرج إلى جعفر: أدخل أنت» is a rescript from an Imam, with no Imam named in the chain: needs ruling (rule 11).
Ja'far, Ali b. Ahmad and the Imam Abu Muhammad are in the scene of the story, not links.
